results.description:
Big lessons. Bold illustrations. Life-changing habits!

Sean Covey's 10-million-copy bestseller The 7 Habits of Highly Effective Teens comes to life in this fun and engaging graphic novel. Filled with colorful illustrations, relatable characters, and real-life challenges, this inspiring adaptation helps teens build confidence, make better choices, strengthen relationships, and take charge of their lives.

Through entertaining stories and practical lessons, young readers discover how powerful habits—like being proactive, thinking win-win, and putting first things first—can help them navigate friendships, resist peer pressure, achieve their goals, and face life's challenges with confidence.

Perfect for teens, tweens, and visual learners, this graphic novel makes personal growth approachable, relevant, and fun.

For parents and educators: This engaging adaptation offers a fresh way to introduce young people to essential life skills, encouraging a positive self-image, stronger relationships, personal responsibility, and resilience.

Book highlights:

• Bold, colorful illustrations and engaging graphic-novel storytelling
• Relatable characters facing real-life challenges
• Practical lessons based on Sean Covey's bestselling 7 Habits principles
• 208-page paperback
• Recommended for ages 12–18
